mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns due to enhanced present value of future cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (based on 2021-03-15 data), or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly non-farm payrolls growth exceeding 200,000 jobs signals robust labor market conditions, which typically precede corporate earnings growth and drive positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS > 200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals an economic 'stagflation' risk, prompting the Federal Reserve to delay rate hikes and causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to heightened uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both UNRATE and CPIAUCSL rise month-over-month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and rising), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward 20-day returns as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations and slow economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.6 million units signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST > 1600, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 550,000 million dollars signals weak consumer spending, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as corporate revenue growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when RSAFS < 550, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% for at least 6 months signals an extended monetary easing cycle, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns due to persistent low discount rates and accommodative policy.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5 for 6 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
